newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CEG and Riogas to be auctioned June 19.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CEG and Riogas to be auctioned June 19.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro's state gas company Companhia Estadual de Gas (CEG) and its Riogas subsidiary are being sold in a June 19 privatization auction, the Brazilian state's planning department said on Tuesday.

The two companies are being sold together in a closed envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange, with separate minimum prices to be announced in the final tender document published May 19, the department said in a statement.
CEG supplies natural gas to the city of Rio, while Riogas is responsible for the distribution of natural gas in the interior of Rio de Janeiro state.
